speaking.title: Where you live
speaking.summaryVi: Quê hương, khu phố, ngôi nhà: từ trả lời ngắn Part 1, kể về ngôi nhà thời thơ ấu (Part 2) đến thảo luận nhà ở và đô thị hoá (Part 3).

levels.goalVi: Trả lời câu hỏi Part 1 về nơi ở bằng 3–4 câu: mở đầu tự nhiên, nêu ý chính rồi thêm chi tiết, không lặp lại "I like".
canDo: Mô tả quê hoặc khu mình ở theo khung: lead-in → ý chính → chi tiết → ý thứ hai
Nói thích / không thích bằng ít nhất 3 cách khác "I like / I don't like"
Trả lời câu hỏi "Would you…?" bằng câu điều kiện có lý do

frames.name: Khung mô tả (Description)
frames.formula: Lead-in + pointing phrase + that + Ý 1 → linker + chi tiết → pointing phrase 2 + Ý 2
frames.explanationVi: Mở bằng một cụm dẫn ("Well,…"), báo hiệu ý đầu tiên ("the first thing I'd say is that…"), nêu ý, thêm chi tiết bằng từ nối ("In fact", "especially"), rồi chuyển sang ý thứ hai ("On top of that,…"). Câu trả lời dài hơn và nhiều từ nối hơn thì điểm Fluency cao hơn.
examples: Well, the first thing I'd say about my hometown is that it's a fairly built-up coastal city. In fact, most people live in apartment blocks along the river.
On top of that, I should mention that the local cuisine is quite distinctive, especially the seafood dishes you find in the night markets.

frames.name: Diễn đạt "thích" (Liking)
frames.formula: I'm (really) into… / I'm quite keen on… / I'm a big fan of… / What I love most about X is that + S + V
frames.explanationVi: Giám khảo hỏi "Do you like…?" thì đừng đáp "Yes, I like…" (lặp lại từ trong câu hỏi). Dùng 2–3 cách diễn đạt khác nhau trong một câu trả lời.
examples: What I love most about my neighbourhood is that everything is within walking distance.
I'm quite keen on the parks near my flat, and I'm a big fan of the street food there.

frames.name: Diễn đạt "không thích" (Disliking)
frames.formula: It's not really my cup of tea / I can't stand… / If I'm honest, the one thing that bothers me is that + S + V
frames.explanationVi: Nói điều không thích một cách mềm mại, có lý do, thay vì "I don't like".
examples: If I'm honest, the one thing that bothers me is the traffic congestion during rush hour.
Living right next to a market isn't really my cup of tea, because it gets noisy from five in the morning.

frames.name: Câu hỏi "Would…?" (giả định)
frames.formula: I'd probably + V, mainly because… / If I had the chance, I'd + V / I don't think I'd + V, since…
frames.explanationVi: Câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng "Would you…?" là câu giả định: trả lời bằng "I'd…" và câu điều kiện loại 2 (If + quá khứ, would + V), kèm lý do.
examples: If I had the chance, I'd move somewhere a bit greener, mainly because I'd love to have a garden.
I don't think I'd ever leave my hometown for good, since all my family live there.

vocab.example: I live in a quiet residential area on the edge of the city.
My neighbourhood is full of small cafés.
We moved to the suburbs when I was ten.

vocab.meaningVi: nhiều nhà cửa, đông đúc xây dựng
vocab.example: The city centre is very built-up now.
Hanoi has become a sprawling city.
The street outside my flat is bustling day and night.
Some of the older buildings are a bit run-down.
That part of town has become quite up-market.
There are plenty of amenities within walking distance.
I commute about forty minutes to university.
The local cuisine is famous for its noodle soups.
It is a close-knit community where everyone knows each other.
Traffic congestion is a real problem at rush hour.

questions: Tell me about your hometown.
Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What do you like about the area where you live?
Is there anything you don't like about it?
Would you like to move to another city in the future?
What would you change about your neighbourhood?

fallback.titleVi: Ghép câu trả lời theo khung mô tả
fallback.instructionVi: Chạm các mảnh theo đúng thứ tự của khung: lead-in → ý chính → chi tiết → ý thứ hai.

items.prompt: Tell me about your hometown.
options: the first thing I'd say is that
my hometown is a fairly built-up city by the sea.
most people live in apartment blocks.
the local cuisine is quite distinctive.
items.explainVi: Lead-in "Well," → pointing phrase → ý 1 → "In fact" + chi tiết → "On top of that" + ý 2.

items.prompt: What do you like about the area where you live?
options: what I love most about it is that
the little market at the end of my street.
items.explainVi: Lead-in "Actually," → cách nói "thích" thay cho "I like" → chi tiết bằng "Especially" → cách nói thích thứ hai.

fallback.instructionVi: Điền một từ hoặc cụm từ để câu nghe tự nhiên.

items.prompt: Well, the first thing I'd ___ is that my street is quite narrow.
items.explainVi: "the first thing I'd say / mention is that…" là cụm báo hiệu ý đầu tiên.

items.prompt: I'm quite keen ___ the parks near my flat.
Living next to a busy road isn't really my cup of ___.
items.explainVi: "not my cup of tea" = không hợp gu, không thích.

items.prompt: If I ___ the chance, I'd move somewhere quieter.
items.explainVi: Câu điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, would + V.

fallback.titleVi: Nâng cấp câu trả lời band 5
fallback.instructionVi: Nói (hoặc gõ) lại câu trả lời dưới đây theo khung mô tả, dài 3–4 câu.
fallback.body:
Q: Tell me about your hometown.
Band 5: "My hometown is Da Nang. It is big. It has beaches. I like it."
fallback.model: Well, the first thing I'd say about my hometown, Da Nang, is that it's a bustling coastal city that has grown incredibly fast. In fact, there are new high-rise hotels along the beach almost every year. On top of that, I should mention that the local cuisine is fantastic, especially the seafood.

fallback.titleVi: Thay từ phổ thông bằng từ hay hơn
fallback.instructionVi: Gõ từ trong bài thay cho từ trong ngoặc vuông.

items.prompt: My city is [very big and spreads out] ___ .
The street outside my flat is [busy and full of people] ___ .
Some old buildings in my area are [in bad condition] ___ .
That neighbourhood has become quite [expensive and fashionable] ___ .

fallback.titleVi: Đoán từ qua lời giải thích
fallback.instructionVi: Chọn từ khớp với lời giải thích tiếng Anh.

items.prompt: Useful places near your home, such as shops, schools and parks.
The journey you make every day between home and work or school.
An area on the edge of a city where people live, usually quieter than the centre.
A group of people who know and help each other.
items.explainVi: close-knit community = cộng đồng gắn bó.

fallback.instructionVi: Chọn từ đi kèm tự nhiên nhất.

items.prompt: a quiet ___ area
traffic ___ at rush hour
the local ___ is famous for noodle soup
items.explainVi: local cuisine = ẩm thực địa phương.

items.prompt: a close-___ community

fallback.instructionVi: Trả lời câu hỏi trong 30 giây, dùng các từ bắt buộc.
fallback.body: What do you like about the area where you live?
fallback.model: Actually, what I love most about my area is that all the amenities are within walking distance, so I hardly ever need my motorbike. I'm also quite keen on the little park nearby, especially early in the morning.

fallback.titleVi: Ý tiếng Việt → nói tiếng Anh
fallback.instructionVi: Nói ý dưới đây bằng tiếng Anh, dùng cụm được gợi ý.
fallback.body: Thật lòng mà nói, điều duy nhất làm tôi khó chịu là tắc đường vào giờ cao điểm, vì tôi mất gần một tiếng để đi học.
fallback.model: If I'm honest, the one thing that bothers me is the traffic congestion at rush hour, because my commute to university takes almost an hour.

fallback.instructionVi: Biến câu trả lời một câu thành 3 ý có từ nối.
fallback.body:
Q: Would you like to move to another city in the future?
A: "Yes, I would like to move to Ho Chi Minh City."
fallback.model: I'd probably move to Ho Chi Minh City at some point, mainly because there are far more job opportunities there. In fact, a lot of my friends have already moved. That said, I don't think I'd stay forever, since I'd miss my family.

fallback.instructionVi: Trả lời từng câu hỏi bằng 3–4 câu, dùng khung câu và từ của bài.

fallback.instructionVi: Giám khảo hỏi nhanh nhiều câu ngắn — trả lời ngay, mỗi câu 2–3 câu.
fallback.persona: A brisk examiner who moves quickly from one question to the next.

What is the best thing about it?
How do you usually get around?

levels.goalVi: Nói liền 1,5–2 phút về một cue card: mỗi gợi ý mở bằng một câu nối cố định, có chi tiết, có thì quá khứ và hiện tại hoàn thành.
canDo: Mở mỗi gợi ý trên cue card bằng một câu nối đã luyện, giữ nguyên cấu trúc gợi ý
Kể thói quen trong quá khứ bằng used to / would
Nối quá khứ với hiện tại bằng thì hiện tại hoàn thành

frames.name: Mở bài Part 2 (gợi ý 1)
frames.formula: I guess I could begin by saying something about + [gợi ý 1], and…
frames.explanationVi: Ghép nguyên văn gợi ý 1 vào câu nối mở đầu (đổi "you" thành "I"). Câu này vừa cho bạn thời gian nghĩ vừa là một câu phức.
examples: I guess I could begin by saying something about where it was, and I'd have to say it was tucked away in a narrow alley in the old quarter.

frames.name: Chuyển sang gợi ý 2–3
frames.formula: Moving on to + [gợi ý], I really need to mention that… / As for + [gợi ý], the point I'd like to make is that…
frames.explanationVi: Mỗi gợi ý giữa bài mở bằng một câu chuyển khác nhau, không lặp lại cùng một câu.
examples: Moving on to what it looked like, I really need to mention that it was a tiny two-storey house with a courtyard at the back.
As for who I lived there with, the point I'd like to make is that it was a typical extended family.
markers: the point i'd like to make

frames.name: Gợi ý cuối (explain…)
frames.formula: And finally, in answer to the question of + [gợi ý], I'd have to say that…
frames.explanationVi: Gợi ý cuối thường là "explain…": đây là chỗ nói cảm xúc và lý do, dùng câu phức dài nhất.
examples: And finally, in answer to the question of how I felt about living there, I'd have to say that I look back on those years with really fond memories.

frames.name: Thói quen quá khứ: used to / would
frames.formula: S + used to + V (trạng thái, thói quen đã hết) · S + would + V (hành động lặp lại trong quá khứ)
frames.explanationVi: "used to" dùng cho cả trạng thái lẫn hành động; "would" chỉ dùng cho hành động lặp lại (không dùng cho trạng thái như live, have, be).
examples: We used to live with my grandparents.
Every summer evening, we would sit in the courtyard and chat.

frames.name: Hiện tại hoàn thành: nối quá khứ – hiện tại
frames.formula: S + have/has + V3 + since/for… · It's been + thời gian + since + S + V2
frames.explanationVi: Dùng để nói điều đã thay đổi đến nay hoặc khoảng thời gian từ quá khứ đến hiện tại.
examples: It's been almost ten years since we moved out.
The house has been renovated twice since then.

vocab.example: My bedroom was quite cramped, but I loved it.
The living room was surprisingly spacious.
It was small but very cosy in winter.
The house was tucked away at the end of a lane.
It was a stone's throw from my primary school.
We had a small courtyard full of plants.
I grew up in an extended family of nine people.
My parents renovated the kitchen last year.
The house has a lot of sentimental value for me.
I look back on my childhood there with pleasure.
I have very fond memories of that place.

questions: Do you still visit that place?
Would you like your own children to grow up in a similar home?

prompts: and explain how you felt about living there

fallback.titleVi: Chuỗi câu nối cho cả cue card
fallback.instructionVi: Nói 4 câu mở đầu cho 4 gợi ý (mỗi câu thêm một ý ngắn).
fallback.body:
Describe your childhood home.
You should say: where it was; what it looked like; who you lived there with; and explain how you felt about living there
fallback.model: I guess I could begin by saying something about where it was, and it was in a quiet lane in the old quarter. Moving on to what it looked like, I really need to mention that it was a cramped but cosy two-storey house. As for who I lived there with, the point I'd like to make is that it was a big extended family. And finally, in answer to the question of how I felt about living there, I'd have to say that I look back on it with fond memories.

fallback.instructionVi: Đọc cue card, chuẩn bị 1 phút, rồi nói liền tối đa 2 phút.

levels.goalVi: Thảo luận các vấn đề về nhà ở và đô thị: so sánh, dự đoán, nêu ưu/nhược điểm và giải pháp bằng các khung câu Part 3.
canDo: So sánh hai thứ bằng whereas / while on the other hand thay vì liệt kê
So sánh xưa – nay bằng used to + hiện tại / hiện tại hoàn thành
Dự đoán và đề xuất giải pháp bằng câu phức

frames.name: So sánh (Comparing)
frames.formula: Well obviously there are a number of differences. I suppose the most significant would be that + S + V, whereas + S + V. On top of this, another distinction might be that…, while on the other hand…
frames.explanationVi: Điểm không nằm ở số khác biệt mà ở cấu trúc so sánh: chỉ cần 2 khác biệt, mỗi cái nói bằng một cặp mệnh đề nối bằng whereas / while on the other hand.
examples: I suppose the most significant difference would be that young people prefer city apartments, whereas older people tend to stay in the family house.

frames.name: So sánh xưa – nay
frames.formula: X used to + V…, but nowadays X + V (hiện tại) · X has/have + V3 (sự thay đổi)
frames.explanationVi: Câu hỏi "How have homes changed…?" thực chất là so sánh quá khứ với hiện tại.
examples: Homes used to be much bigger and shared by three generations, but nowadays most young couples live on their own.
Property prices have soared over the last decade.

frames.name: Dự đoán (Predicting)
frames.formula: I'd imagine that… will probably… / It's quite likely that… / In the foreseeable future, …
frames.explanationVi: Dùng nhiều cách diễn đạt tương lai khác nhau, kèm mức độ chắc chắn.
examples: I'd imagine that people will probably live in smaller, high-density flats in the foreseeable future.

frames.name: Ưu điểm – nhược điểm
frames.formula: One clear advantage is that… / The main drawback, though, is that… / Not to mention the fact that…
frames.explanationVi: Mỗi ưu/nhược điểm cần một câu giải thích hoặc ví dụ đi kèm.
examples: One clear advantage of high-rise living is that it saves land. The main drawback, though, is the lack of green space.

frames.name: Vấn đề – giải pháp
frames.formula: One fundamental concern is that… / The most effective way to tackle this would be to + V
frames.explanationVi: Nêu vấn đề rồi đề xuất giải pháp bằng câu có would / could.
examples: One fundamental concern is the housing shortage. The most effective way to tackle this would be to build more affordable housing near transport links.

vocab.example: Rapid urbanisation has changed the way people live.
Big cities are facing a serious housing shortage.
The government should invest in affordable housing.
Urban sprawl swallows up farmland.
The infrastructure cannot keep up with the population.

vocab.meaningVi: di cư từ nông thôn ra thành thị
vocab.example: Rural-urban migration puts pressure on cities.
Green space improves our quality of life.
Some districts are badly overcrowded.
Children need green space to play.
Property prices have soared in recent years.
High-density housing saves land.
Apartment blocks can lack a sense of community.

questions: How are homes today different from homes thirty years ago in your country?
Why do so many young people move from the countryside to big cities?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a high-rise apartment?
Do you think people will live in smaller homes in the future?
